help_subtitle: Quick answers to the most common questions about verifykm.
help_faq_1_q: Where do I find my VIN number?
help_faq_1_a: Your 17-character VIN is on the driver's side dashboard (visible through the windshield), the driver's door jamb sticker, your vehicle title, insurance card, or registration documents.
help_faq_2_q: How long does a report take?
help_faq_2_a: Most reports are delivered within seconds after payment is confirmed. In rare cases, while our system is still checking available databases, delivery may take longer — we'll email you when your report is ready.
help_faq_3_q: What countries and vehicles are supported?
help_faq_3_a: We support vehicles from all major markets including USA, South Korea, EU, UK, and many more. Any valid 17-character VIN from a recognized manufacturer is supported.
help_faq_4_q: Can I get a refund if no data is found?
help_faq_4_a: Yes. If our provider returns no data for your VIN, you are entitled to a full refund. Contact support with your VIN and order details and we will process it promptly.
help_faq_5_a: All payments are processed securely by PayPal. We never store your card details. You can pay with any major card or your PayPal account.
help_contact_desc: Our support team is available 7 days a week. Send us an email and we'll get back to you within a few hours.
